levels.implemented: Works in the running app and matches the reference evidence.
levels.partial: Reachable in the running app but incomplete against the reference.
levels.unwired: UI and/or backend exist but the running app never reaches them with real data.
levels.backend-only: Logic exists and is tested, but no command or UI in the app reaches it (includes modules not declared in src-tauri/src/lib.rs).

chat.session-stream.why: #272/#371: reasonChat.ts stored() loads each chat through the registered chat_messages_load and rebuilds it with persist.ts restoreEvents (a turn running at quit reloads as cancelled); apply() and resetReasonChat save through ChatSaver into chat_messages_save (sessions/session_messages), so transcripts survive a restart. #271 still open: configureReason is only called from ReviewButton.tsx, so the main chat opens with no model or effort; the registered claude_* commands have no caller. The sessions row gets only id, claude_session_id and last_user_message_at, and the follow-up queue (queue_order, queue_paused_at) is still in memory.
chat.session-stream.obligation: #271: pass the selected agent, model and effort for the main chat (configureReason from firstSession and the default model before the first prompt, plus set_config_option on a live Session). #272: persist sessions and session_messages (full_message, turn_id, cancelled_at) and reload them on reopen. Add a registered Claude Code / Codex runner.

chat.markdown.why: #339: Transcript.tsx Part renders assistant text through markdown.ts Markdown (react-markdown + remark-gfm + remark-breaks, lowlight highlighting capped at 100k chars, code blocks with Copy, inline-code URLs as links, escaped raw HTML, links via openUrl). Code-level verdict: the browser-build capture has no assistant message, so the rendering is not shown in screens/. Thinking blocks and user text stay plain.
chat.markdown.obligation: Render assistant text blocks as markdown with inline code, lists and syntax-highlighted code blocks.

chat.tool-calls.why: #339: toolGroups.ts foldAgentRows/groupParts feed Transcript.tsx SummaryRow, 'N tool calls, M messages' with one icon per tool, open while the turn runs and collapsed after. Garry Mode (#332, AppPrefRows.tsx, ⌃O) reaches Transcript only as expandToolsByDefault; WorkspaceView never passes dontCollapseToolCalls, so groups still collapse after each turn. ToolRow still shows raw JSON input and result instead of per-tool rendering.
chat.tool-calls.obligation: Group consecutive tool calls and intermediate text under one collapsible 'N tool calls, M messages' header, and add the keep-expanded setting wired to expandToolsByDefault.

chat.composer-send.why: Composer.tsx and queue.ts unchanged since 1cedef0. #376: the first message of a new chat gets the effective prompts.general (reasonChat.ts withGeneral via the registered repo_settings_effective). Still no followUpMode passed from WorkspaceView, no model chip, attach button or focus hint, and the selected model and effort never reach the main chat (#271).
chat.composer-send.obligation: Add the send-key and follow-up-behavior settings and pass followUpMode into Composer. Add the composer model chip/picker wired to the Session model and effort (#271), the attach button and the focus hint.

chat.queue.why: New in #303: queue.ts (submit :89, drain :77, turnEnded :108, where a failed turn pauses a non-empty queue, pause/resume :121-128, saveEdit/steerQueued :148/:184, move/reorder) is run by reasonChat.ts setQueue/run (:99-121). Composer QueuePanel (:112) and QueueRow (:157) render a 'Queue paused'/'Queued' header with Pause/Resume, Collapse, and per-row ↑/↓, Edit (Save / Save and steer), Steer and Delete. These are reachable in the app, and the queue behaviour (evidence/chat-queue/README.md) matches. Gaps: the queue lives only in the in-memory Chat (reasonChat.ts:46), and nothing writes queue_order or queue_paused_at, so it is lost on restart. Reorder is buttons, not drag. The chat.queue.* and chat.queueEdit.* keybindings (registry.ts:30) still have no handlers; the edit textarea hard-codes Enter and Escape (Composer.tsx:168-173).
chat.queue.obligation: Persist the queue (session_messages.queue_order, sessions.queue_paused_at) and restore it on reopen. Add drag reorder. Bind the chat.queue.* / chat.queueEdit.* keybindings instead of the hard-coded keys.

chat.cancel.why: Stop calls the registered reason_cancel (a Stop before the prompt is sent is held for that turn). #339: a stopped prompt shows 'Cancelled' and its turn footer an 'Interrupted by user' badge (Transcript.tsx, view.ts cancelledAt); the e2e waits for the badge. #371: cancelled_at is saved to session_messages and reloaded, and a turn left running at quit reloads as cancelled. Implemented for the Reason runner the app uses; claude_cancel is registered but uncalled.
chat.cancel.obligation: Render the cancelled-message state ('Interrupted by user' badge driven by cancelledAt) and persist session_messages.cancelled_at. Wire Stop to the Claude Code and Codex runners once they exist.

chat.attachments.why: Re-read at 247d5a1: unchanged (#369 is rustfmt only; #315/#345/#386 only add settings and sidebar commands to lib.rs). The only attachment sources are the revert note after a discard (WorkspaceView.tsx bridge.attach) and the review prompt, sent as resource blocks with reason_prompt. Nothing outside src/features/draft-attachments imports draftAttachmentsApi; no attach button, ⌘U, or file/image/paste/drag input.
chat.attachments.obligation: Mount draft attachments in the composer (attach button, ⌘U, drag/paste of files, images and terminal output) on draftAttachmentsApi, and materialize them on send with draft_attachments_materialize / materialize_local_path_attachment, recording attachments.is_draft. Show them as chips on sent messages.

chat.model-picker.why: Settings › Default models (settings/DefaultModelsPage.tsx) saves models.default, and CreateWorkspaceDialog builds firstSession {agent, model, effort} from it. seedTranscript and sendReason forward only the message text, so the chosen model and effort never reach a running agent. There is no composer picker like menu--model-picker's 'Opus 5 High' chip, no favorites, and no per-session effort, and chat.openModelPicker has no handler. Re-read at 1cedef0: #285 adds settings::launch (claude_launch/codex_launch map models.default/models.review and effort to CLI args), tested but called only from launch_tests.rs. The Reason chat still opens with config [], so the chosen model and effort still never reach the agent (#271).
chat.model-picker.obligation: Add the composer model picker with favorites and per-session effort, persisted to sessions (claude_effort_level, codex_thinking_level), and pass the model and effort into the agent launch.

chat.plan-mode.why: PermissionMode::Plan exists only in agent/claude_cli.rs launch args, and no registered command launches Claude. chat.togglePlanMode and chat.approvePlan are keybinding registry entries with no handler, and no plan approval UI exists. Default to plan mode is explicitly omitted from DefaultModelsPage. Re-read at 1cedef0: #285's settings::launch::claude_launch sets permission mode, model, --effort and --settings from settings.toml, but it is called only from settings/launch_tests.rs; claude_chat does not use it and no UI toggles plan mode.
chat.plan-mode.obligation: Add a plan-mode toggle to the composer (Shift+Tab), pass it to the agent launch, and show the plan review/approve step in the transcript.

chat.context-usage.why: No code reads or shows context usage or compaction. reason_acp/updates.rs parse_update explicitly returns None for usage updates, and sessions.context_used_percent and is_compacting are schema only.
chat.context-usage.obligation: Show a per-session context window usage meter and compaction state, fed by agent usage events.

chat.message-actions.why: Copy message, Copy final message, Retry, TurnMenu Reset chat and the TurnChanges chips unchanged, and now also work on transcripts reloaded from conductor.db (#371). chat.forkToNewTab has no handler; no edit-and-resend, Fork chat, or duration/time chips in the turn footer.
chat.message-actions.obligation: Add edit-and-resend and 'Fork chat' (a registered fork command creating a session from a turn), plus the footer's duration, time and changed-files chips.

chat.tabs.why: MainTabs in WorkspaceView.tsx renders one chat tab titled with the workspace name (plus the 'All changes' diff tab), and the chat id is the workspace id. There is no '+', and no multiple sessions or per-session titles. Workspace.unread is read by Sidebar.tsx but nothing sets it.
chat.tabs.obligation: Support several chat sessions per workspace as tabs, with a '+' button, session titles and unread counts, backed by sessions rows.

chat.revert-checkpoint.why: #371: resetReasonChat restores through checkpoint_exists/checkpoint_restore, truncates the transcript, and ChatSaver's diffForSave deletes the dropped turns from session_messages. Reloaded turns keep their chatId:uuid turn ids, so checkpoints are found after a restart. The Reason Session is still not rewound (ACP cannot drop turns), so the agent remembers the deleted turns.
chat.revert-checkpoint.obligation: Persist turns in session_messages (turn_id), delete messages after the watermark in storage, rewind or re-seed the agent session after a reset, and apply checkpointing to the Claude Code and Codex runners.

chat.speech.why: No dictation or speech code exists in src/ or src-tauri/src (ledger agent.speech).
chat.speech.obligation: Add speech-to-text dictation into the composer.

chat.find.why: The only find bar is features/terminal/FindBar.tsx, which covers terminals. chat.search, searchNext and searchPrevious exist only as keybinding registry entries with no handler, and the transcript has no find UI.
chat.find.obligation: Add find-in-transcript (top-level messages) bound to chat.search, with next/previous match navigation.

diff.changes-list.why: #373: 'All changes' is diffed against the workspace's target ref: target.ts targetBranch picks the open unmerged PR's base (from onLookup), else intended_target_branch (now carried by db_list_workspaces and mapped in persisted.ts), else the repo default; diff/git.rs resolves refs/remotes/origin/<branch> when present and takes the merge base with it. workspace.showUncommittedChanges (⌘⌥U) is bound in RightPanel and toggles Changes/Uncommitted ↔ All changes, matching evidence/diff/target-ref.md. Remaining differences: remote is always 'origin' (repos.remote never filled), no Graphite stack parent. Code-level; native app not run.
diff.changes-list.obligation: Diff 'All changes' against the workspace target ref (origin/<target branch>) and bind workspace.showUncommittedChanges (Cmd+Alt+U) to open the list in Uncommitted scope.

diff.file-render.why: FileDiffView.tsx unchanged: Pierre CodeView themed by useDiffTheme (#356 follows the Code theme), worker pool, hunks from diff_workspace. WrapLines.tsx deletion only removes the dead WrapToggle; wrap comes from the View options menu.

diff.split-unified.why: No change: LAYOUT_TITLE still reads 'Unified view' / 'Split view' / 'Entire file' (DiffViewer.tsx:30) and LayoutToggle still drives Pierre diffStyle.

diff.virtualized.why: Since #282 FileDiffView renders the open file as the single item of a Pierre CodeView in a fixed-height .oc-code-view scroller, so only rows near the viewport render and revealLine scrolls unrendered lines into view. That is what evidence/frontend/pierre-diff-options.md records for Conductor (one-item CodeView per open file). The same evidence shows no windowing on Conductor's Changes list, so the unvirtualized ChangesList matches (inferred from the bundle).

diff.whitespace.why: No change: ViewOptionsMenu is still mounted in DiffTab (DiffViewer.tsx:92) with the 'Hide whitespace changes' / 'Wrap lines' items (Whitespace.tsx:33-34). The #270 file-list fix and the WhitespaceOnly state are intact.

diff.viewed.why: No change: ViewedToggle is still mounted at FileDiffView.tsx:211 (defined at :222), with the 'Mark as viewed' / 'Mark as not viewed' tooltip and diff.toggleViewed.

diff.navigation.why: Unchanged: useCommentNavigation and the mounted CommentNav give floating Previous/Next comment buttons with counts; diff.nextFile/previousFile and nextComment/previousComment keybindings intact.

diff.turn-changes.why: #371 stores each message's turnId in session_messages (chat_messages_save) and restoreEvents rebuilds turns on open, so restored turns keep their ids and turnFooter finds their chips in the cache or reloads them through checkpoint_turn_changes. The chip cache is still webview localStorage (useTurnChanges.ts), and chipLayout shows TURN_CHIPS_SHOWN-1 chips plus an overflow button against the reference's first 3.
diff.turn-changes.obligation: Persist turn ids with the transcript so chips survive a resume or restart, move the cache into the db.local-storage subsystem, and settle the 2-vs-3 visible-chip count against evidence/diff/turn-changes.md.

diff.discard.why: #373: the context-menu Discard calls askDiscard(file, 'menu'), and discardScope('menu', …) always restores from the 'All changes' base (merge base with the target ref) in every view; the revert icons keep the view's scope and stay hidden in the turn view (canDiscard). REA plus a bundle read of Conductor 0.87.6 (evidence/diff/target-ref.md) shows Conductor also offers the menu Discard in the turn view, so not hiding it there matches the reference. DiffDiscardHost still attaches revertedNote after a discard.
diff.discard.obligation: Context-menu discard always uses the 'All changes' base in every view (Conductor 0.87.6 offers it in the turn view too); revert icons use the view scope and are hidden in the turn view.

diff.comments-inline.why: Unchanged: enableLineSelection with a controlled range; threads persisted through the registered diff_comment_add/edit/delete/resolve/list. Only addition is the read-only hasPendingComments helper (comments.ts).

diff.comments-to-chat.why: #344: control.ts offers 'Add all comments to chat' in the PR header when changes are requested and comments are pending; PrControl calls review.addAllToChat. It is still toChat: formatForAgent text pasted through chat.insert into whichever chat is showing, then diff_comments_mark_sent; no comment_id attachment; toolbar still reads 'Add N comments to chat'. Bug: hasPendingComments counts PR-level and empty-body comments that pendingForAgent excludes, so the header button can appear and do nothing.
diff.comments-to-chat.obligation: Attach comments as composer attachments carrying comment_id instead of pasting text, use 'Add all comments to chat' (and 'Add all GitHub comments to chat' for remote ones), and route them to the workspace chat rather than a visible review chat.

diff.comments-github.why: Unchanged: pr/review_comments.rs sync via the registered diff_comments_sync_github and diff_comment_resolve_github. Bodies render as plain spans or SuggestedChange, not markdown (chat/markdown.ts exists since #339). Delete is local-only; no 'Add all GitHub comments to chat', no resolve success/failure messages, no PR-level comments without a file open.
diff.comments-github.obligation: Render comment bodies as markdown and add Delete for remote comments. Add 'Add all GitHub comments to chat' and the resolve success/failure messages, store the old side as the reference's 'original' (or read both), and show PR-level comments without needing a file open.

diff.edit-in-viewer.why: There is no editor in the diff tab and no file-write command. The reference copy 'Edit in diff viewer' appears nowhere in src.
diff.edit-in-viewer.obligation: Let the user edit the file from the diff viewer and save it to the worktree, then refresh the diff.

diff.appearance.why: Code theme (useDiffTheme), fonts, ligatures and color_vision are in place; #331 moved 'Wrap lines' into View options. wrapLines is still stored in the localStorage diff options (types.ts:47-51), not Conductor's wrap_lines settings row.
diff.appearance.obligation: Store wrap lines as the wrap_lines setting (default true) through get_settings/update_settings.

pr.create.why: usePrActions.create builds its request with createPrRequest (createPr.ts), which calls the registered pr_template and db_repo_prompt('createPR') and passes workspace prTitle/prDescription to pr_create_prompt. The lookup now saves title and body via pr_sync_workspace -> workspaces::set_pr_metadata and db_list_workspaces reloads them. Gap: #376's prompts.create_pr settings-file fallback in pr_create_prompt only runs with repo_path set, and createPrRequest never sends repoPath/workspacePath.
pr.create.obligation: In usePrActions.create, pass db_repo_prompt(repoId, 'createPR') and the repo's PR template to pr_create_prompt as customInstructions and template. Add a registered command (info::metadata_update) that saves the PR title and body to workspaces.pr_title and pr_description on each lookup.

pr.custom-prompts.why: #301 registered db_repo_prompt (persistence_commands.rs; lib.rs:296), reading all six custom_prompt_* kinds; the running app reads codeReview for the Review button (reviewApi.ts:9). There is no UI to edit any prompt, and createPR, fixErrors, resolveMergeConflicts, renameBranch and general are read nowhere.
pr.custom-prompts.obligation: Add per-repo prompt editing through a registered write command, and read createPR, fixErrors, resolveMergeConflicts and renameBranch in their flows.

pr.status.why: usePullRequest polls the registered pr_lookup, pr_git_state and pr_header_state with the real hasPendingComments (review.hasPending) and optionalChecksBlock (usePrSettings); PrControl labels every header state (draft, review required, changes requested, merged, 'Loading PR…'). #344's useWorkspacePrSync -> pr_sync_workspace stores derivedStatus with the reference's clear-manual-status rule (workspaces::set_derived_status). Only the open workspace is polled, which is all the header needs. Code-level; not run in the macOS app.
pr.status.obligation: Store pr_lookup's derivedStatus (and PR title/description) per workspace, poll every workspace in a batch, and feed the real pending-comment flag and optional-checks-blocking setting into header_state.

pr.checks.why: Changed: c1436d2 (#309) made usePullRequest.ts:45-71 read treat_optional_checks_as_blocking through usePrSettings (getSettings, re-read on SETTINGS_CHANGED) and pass it to pr_header_state. WorkspaceView.tsx:373 now passes it to mergeShortcutApplies, and the Settings › Git row is at GitPage.tsx:123-131. ChecksTab is still mounted from RightPanel (WorkspaceView.tsx:231), and checks/api.ts:15 and :24 call pr_check_log and pr_rerun_failed_checks (both registered, lib.rs:365-366). 'Fix errors' is still missing, and Re-run still shows only for Actions-job URLs (checks.ts:66-67), while NOTES:32 shows it for any failing check with a details URL.
pr.checks.obligation: Add 'Fix errors': send the failing jobs' logs plus db_repo_prompt 'fixErrors' to the agent as a reason_prompt attachment. Show Re-run whenever a failing check has a details URL, as in NOTES:32, or record the narrower rule as a deliberate difference.

pr.merge.why: Merge, Automerge and Cancel automerge in PrControl call the registered pr_merge, pr_merge_method and pr_set_auto_merge; git.mergePR goes through mergeShortcutApplies. The TS canMerge (shortcuts.ts) and Rust merge_eligibility::can_merge now share src-tauri/src/pr/fixtures/can_merge_cases.json in their tests, so they cannot drift silently.

pr.archive-on-merge.why: Unchanged: onLookup (WorkspaceView.tsx) archives only the open workspace through db_archive_workspace, which only flips the row's state. pr_sync_workspace now writes derived_status 'done' on merge but does not archive. Missing: watch every workspace, per-repo override, toast Open PR/Unarchive, full archive (archive_commit + worktree cleanup), stacked-PR exception.
pr.archive-on-merge.obligation: Watch the PR state of every workspace, not only the open one. Add the per-repo override, Open PR and Unarchive actions on the toast, a full archive that records archive_commit and cleans up the worktree, and the stacked-PR exception.

pr.commit-push.why: #344: header::header_state returns CommitAndPush on uncommitted changes; control.ts maps it to a 'Commit and push' button and git.commitAndPush (⌘⇧Y, gated by commitShortcutApplies). Both send the registered pr_commit_and_push_prompt ('Commit and push all changes') to the workspace agent via chat.send, matching evidence/pr/NOTES.md (agent instruction, no git command in the app). Code-level; not run in the macOS app.
pr.commit-push.obligation: Implement a commit-and-push-all command, or the agent prompt the reference uses, and wire it to the header CommitAndPush action and the git.commitAndPush keybinding.

pr.review-actions.why: Unchanged since a693ae8: Ready for review and Approve PR call the registered pr_mark_ready and pr_approve; PrHeader inside the Checks tab calls pr_edit and pr_retarget. No separate PR tab, and no per-workspace target branch (intended_target_branch) that triggers a retarget.
pr.review-actions.obligation: Add the separate PR tab that holds the PR header, and a per-workspace target branch (intended_target_branch) whose change retargets an open, unmerged PR through pr_retarget, as the reference does at ~3,321,350.

pr.ai-review.why: #376: useReviewChats.start uses reviewPreferences (effective prompts.code_review from repo_settings_effective, falling back to db_repo_prompt 'codeReview') and opens a 'Review N' chat on the review model via reason_open_chat/reason_prompt. Still shown on the Checks tab, no detached-HEAD refusal or read-only gating, findings arrive as chat text not inline diff comments, review tabs are in-memory only.
pr.ai-review.obligation: Hide Review on the Checks tab, refuse on detached HEAD, gate read-only workspaces, land findings as inline diff comments, persist review tabs.

pr.resolve-conflicts.why: #344: on merge_conflicts (DIRTY) PrControl shows Resolve, and resolveConflicts sends the registered pr_resolve_conflicts_prompt (reads pull.rebase: rebase with --force-with-lease or merge; targets baseRefName or targetBranch; appends db_repo_prompt('resolveMergeConflicts')), matching NOTES.md. Diff shows the operation-in-progress message. Gap: the header Archive has no busy check during a merge or rebase (workspace::git::busy_state is unreachable from the UI); the reference gates Spotlight and archive.
pr.resolve-conflicts.obligation: Add the Resolve conflicts header action, shown when header_state returns MergeConflicts or a merge or rebase is in progress, that sends the resolve-conflicts prompt (with the repo custom prompt) to the agent, and block the other git and PR actions while the operation runs.

pr.workspace-from-pr.why: App.tsx mounts CreateWorkspaceDialog, whose CreateFromPicker has a 'Pull requests' tab filled by the registered pr_list_open (bundled gh, list.rs), and gh_issue_list_open fills the Issues tab. Choosing a PR sends existingBranch and prNumber to create_workspace, which fetches pull/<n>/head for forks. Search only filters the first 100 open PRs on the client (createFrom.ts `matches`). A pasted PR outside that list gives 'Could not load that pull request', because NOTES confirms the reference's server-side search/issues and pulls/{n} lookup were not built.
pr.workspace-from-pr.obligation: Add search-as-you-type over all PRs (gh search prs or search/issues) and by-number or URL lookup (gh pr view), then create the workspace from the result and link it to the PR.

pr.stack.why: src-tauri and src/ have no stack model, merge-stack command or stack UI. NOTES lists stacked-PR header states and the stack exception to archive-on-merge as not modelled.
pr.stack.obligation: Model dependent PR stacks (fetch stack fields), show the stack view, and implement merge-stack with its failure state.
